## How to contribute

1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/YOUR_ORG/wiki.git`
2. Add or edit a `.qmd` or `.ipynb` file in the right folder
3. Push to `main` — the site rebuilds automatically

> **Tip:** Notion users can export pages as Markdown and drop them into `docs/`.
